newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria appoints new Balkan Airlines board.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria appoints new Balkan Airlines board.

text.p: Bulgaria's Finance Ministry has replaced the board of directors of Bulgaria's debt-ridden Balkan Airlines in a bid to stabilise the state carrier's finances, Bulgarian radio said on Monday.
The radio said Valeri Doganov would manage the firm. Doganov was the airline's executive director in 1994.
Last month trade unions accused the board of being unable to manage the firm.
Balkan, hit by heavy losses in recent years, is expected to increase its debts by $15 million this year, transport ministry officials said.
